Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- Freecam now glides smoothly instead of moving in small jumps.
- Freecam up/down now works with E (up) and Q (down), whatever those keys are bound to. While the camera is moving they won't fire your hotbar skills, and they type normally in chat. Your Jump and Descend keys still work too.
- Freecam up/down movement is slower, so it's easier to line up a shot.

Quick Library

Pairing

- Picking one role of a couple animation can send your partner the other role.
